title: Rotopounamu Track: Tongariro National Park, Central North Island region
overview: This track circles a beautiful lake surrounded by native forest and is a special favourite of tree lovers, birdwatchers, and families.
No dogs. Other pets on conservation land rules.
lines: Department of Conservation Te Papa Atawhai
Department of Conservation | Te Papa Atawhai
11 km from Tūrangi off SH47, the parking area is signposted on the south side of Te Ponanga Saddle.
Dogs are not permitted on this track.
